title: Scenario Kernel Language Binding
description: Manifest proving that one language implementation claims conformance to an admitted Scenario Kernel specification.

language.description: Open target identity. Admission is resolved through language-target-registration.v1 rather than a closed schema enum.

status.description: Declared lifecycle INTENT only — a human/team decision about whether work on this language has started, nothing more. DECLARED bindings are intent only and are not yet active conformance obligations. Deliberately excludes CONFORMING/ADMITTED: whether an implementation has actually reached those states is a PROVEN fact computed by the conformance harness, not something hand-set here — see artifacts/conformance/<language>.conformance-result.json's admissionDisposition for the authoritative, computed answer. A prior version of this schema allowed CONFORMING/ADMITTED here and a binding manifest drifted out of sync with computed reality as a result; narrowed to prevent that recurring.
